payout_quote: To receive the $100 bonus: within 60 days of opening, open a Free Checking or Extra Value Checking account, enroll in eStatements, maintain at least $50 in checking, and set up direct deposit, Online/Mobile Banking, or Bill Pay. To receive the $50 debit card bonus: use your Cal Coast Debit Mastercard 10 times per month for 3 months, or 30 times within 90 days.
steps: Join California Coast Credit Union as a new member and open a new Free Checking or Extra Value Checking account using promo code RESET at account opening ($25 minimum opening balance; a one-time $5 membership fee may apply).
Within 60 days of opening: enroll in eStatements, maintain at least $50 in the checking account, and set up direct deposit OR online/mobile banking OR bill pay to earn the $100 new-member bonus.
Use your Cal Coast Debit Mastercard 10 times per month for 3 months (or 30 times within 90 days) to earn the additional $50 debit card bonus.
Keep the account in good standing; bonuses are paid to the savings account within 120 days after the qualifications are met.
catches: New members only; Cal Coast employees are excluded; limited-time offer that can be changed or discontinued at any time without notice; promo code RESET must be used at account opening.

To earn the $100: within 60 days of opening, open a Free Checking or Extra Value Checking account, enroll in eStatements, maintain at least $50 in the checking account, and set up direct deposit OR online/mobile banking OR bill pay.
To earn the additional $50 debit card bonus: use the Cal Coast Debit Mastercard 10 times per month for 3 months, or 30 times within 90 days.
Bonus payments are considered interest and taxed (1099-INT). Monthly $3.75 maintenance fee is waived only for the first 2 months.
A one-time $5 membership fee may apply. Membership and account eligibility requirements apply (San Diego-area community credit union).
The separate $50 referral bonus pays the referring existing member, not the new member — not counted in this route's payout.
biggest_catch: Two separate new-member bonuses stack to $150 — $100 for opening checking + eStatements + $50 balance + direct deposit (or online banking/bill pay) within 60 days, plus another $50 for 30 debit-card swipes within 90 days; promo code RESET required and the $50 referral piece only pays the person who referred you.
eligibility: New Cal Coast members (13+, with a joint owner for ages 13-15); employees excluded; must meet membership and account eligibility requirements; use promo code RESET at account opening.
timing: Incentive bonus payments are paid to the savings account within 120 days after the qualifications are met; reported as taxable interest (1099-INT).
